div.head: ECf 32 A 6
div.ab: Ita debent facere omnes principes et comites, et simul iurare coram episcopis regni in folkesmoth; et similiter omnes proceres regni et milites et liberi homines uniuersi totius regni Britannie facere debent in pleno folkesmot fidelitatem domino regi, ut predictum est, coram episcopis regni.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 655 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints in smaller type across the page as an insertion into ECf retr. 32 (32 A–E, pp. 655–660). The dictionary cites it as “ECf 32 A …”, so it is kept with ECf here.
div.ab: So must all princes and earls do, and swear together before the bishops of the kingdom in the folkesmoth; and likewise all the nobles of the kingdom, and the knights, and all the free men of the whole kingdom of Britain must do fealty to the lord king in full folkesmot, as was said before, before the bishops of the kingdom.
